meta.title: AUD/JPY · AI Price-Action Trader · 1-minute binary expiry · 7-day historical backtest
meta.data_source: Yahoo Finance chart API, symbol AUDJPY=X, interval 1m
meta.indicator: None — autonomous Lovable AI reading raw OHLC candles only (no indicators)
meta.method: Every 30 minutes on closed UTC M3 candles, the AI inspects only the last 20 closed M3 and 10 closed M1 raw OHLC candles (zero lookahead, no indicators) and decides LONG, SHORT, or SKIP. Entry = M3 close; expiry = close of the next 1-minute candle.
disclosures: Zero indicators were used: the AI saw only past raw OHLC candles up to each decision time, never future candles.
Exact tick prices were not available, so expiry uses the 1-minute candle close (last quote before entry + 60 s).
Price data is Yahoo Finance AUDJPY=X, which may differ slightly from Quotex or TradingView quotes.
Forex is closed Friday 22:00 to Sunday 22:00 UTC (Saturday Nov 21 and Sunday Nov 22 have no trades).

info_all_signals.note: Information only — not money. What every AI trade call would have scored if the balance had never run out.
